title: Malai Chicken

ingredients.name: med onions (2 Tbsp oil fry / heat it a little bit) (gravy)

steps: After frying the onions put the chicken and all of the spices and cook till a bit tender.
Gravy: Boil, peel and grind the tomatoes.
Add this to the fried onion, then add the spices.
Dont cook till dry.
Put this gravy and chicken in oven tray and put 500 g of malai and bake for 1/2 an hour.
Add eggs on top after 15 mins and some butter.
If using fresh malai dont use butter.
notes: page 1; malai, eggs and butter are listed from the method, not the ingredient list; the second list of ingredients (salt, onions, tomatoes...) is the gravy

title: Fatayer

ingredients.name: milk powder (can sub with fresh milk) (dough)

steps: Filling: Cook the mince with salt.
Filling: Make a dry gravy of tomatoes and all the other stuff, add the mince.
Filling: Cook a little.
Dough: Make the yeast. Then add the other ingredients.
notes: page 2; the book's "Variations" section lists a second dough (4 cups flour...) with no method; the last "1/2 cup warm water" sits to the right of the yeast line and is probably the water for the yeast

title: Corn Soup
steps: Blend cornflour and shrimps in 2 glasses of water.
Add this to a little heated oil and let it boil and thicken.
Add corn paste and water.
Let it boil nicely.
Then add the egg whites and stir continuously.
Add Ajino moto and stir.
notes: page 3

title: Fried Noodles
steps: Fry all the veg seperately.
notes: page 3; no noodles are listed in the ingredients and no further method is written in the book

title: Punjabi Samosa
steps: Dough: Make firm dough.
Filling: Bagar - Ghee, zeera, dhania and chilli.
Filling: When ready add it to boiled potato cubes.
Filling: When the potatoes are soft put some peas, corriander and green chillies with 1 Tbsp amchoor.
notes: page 4; a word between "corriander" and "(fresh)" on the coriander line is smudged/unreadable; peas, green chillies and amchoor are listed from the method; no shaping/frying method written

title: Chatpatti
steps: Cook till tender, add larg chunks of potato and cook till done.
Chatpatti masala: Roast and grind (when cooled) till just starts to crackle don't make it dark.
notes: page 5; "black powder" in the masala list is as written (possibly black pepper or black salt, not sure); potato is listed from the method, no amount given

title: Carrot Pickle (sticks)
notes: page 5; no method written in the book

title: Shrimp Biryani
steps: First put the garam masala in oil and heat then add the onion, fry till light brown then add tomatoes, ginger, garlic, zeera and other spices and shrimp.
Cook for 5 minutes.
Then put rice as for biryani.
For shrimp pulao the same ingredients except for methi powder, you can add peas and potatoes.
notes: page 6; a small word before "(methi)" on the fenugreek line is faint/smudged, read as "powder" (word before "(methi)" is not certain)

title: Samosa Keema
steps: Cook mince with all the spices till dry.
Add onions, corriander, chillies and peas.
notes: page 7; title on the page is "Samosa Keema"; no pastry or wrapping method written

title: Methi Jhingi
steps: Cook onion, spices together till dry.
Add methi till almost done, add shrimps till cooked.
notes: page 7; page title is "Methi Jhingi (Fenugreek Shrimp)"

title: Pizza
steps: Combine yeast, sugar and warm water in a large bowl.
Stir and let sit for 5 mins.
Mixture must show bubbling action before you proceed.
Next add olive oil, salt and flour to the mixture.
Gradually add the remaining water and knead to form dough 5-6 mins.
The dough should be soft and easy to move when finished.
Cover dough with olive oil.
Leave to rest in warm place until doubled in size (1 1/2 hours).
notes: page 8; dough only, no toppings or baking instructions written; the book says "dive oil" in one place, read as olive oil

title: Mandi / Majboos Masala (Hawaij spice mix)
steps: Roast spices slightly, cool and grind.
notes: page 8

title: Masala Dosa
steps: Batter: Soak overnight and blend till smooth.
notes: page 9; the page also gives two potato tarkari (filling) ingredient lists with no method: "Cubed (Orange) Potato Tarkari" and "Boiled (Yellow) Potato Tarkari"; the right edge of the page is partly cut off in the photo but the lists look complete

title: Coconut Green Chutney
notes: page 9; no amounts for coconut, salt, coriander, lemon juice; no method written in the book

title: Dahi Vada
steps: Make a fine paste, before frying put 1/2 tsp baking soda.
Instead of moong dal you can use urad dal.
notes: page 10; one ingredient line between "ginger" and "cumin seeds" and a phrase after "baking soda" in the method are whited out in the book (left out); no yogurt listed and no assembly method written

title: Shami Kabab
steps: Pressure cook everything till soft (longer if using meat pieces gosht).
Mix all the ingredients, make kababs, fry in oil.
notes: page 10

title: Chicken/Mutton Biryani

ingredients.name: pinch of saffron (chicken and on rice)
bay leaves, extra salt (for the rice)

steps: Fry onion, then add cinnamon, cardamom and clove.
Remove onion and mix with the chicken.
Marinate the chicken with all the spices and tomato puree.
Cook chicken for 10 mins medium heat, cook rice till 80% cooked with (bay leaves, extra salt, badiyan, cloves, cinnamon, cardamom) simultaneously cook chicken on low heat.
Put fried potatoes, mint (in rice and chicken), then rice and saffron, raisins and ghee onions.
Cook on high till it collects steam 5-10 mins.
Cook on low for 12-15 mins.
Note: Bay leaves, cinnamon stick, star anise, clove, cardamom and mint leaves in rice.
In gravy cinnamon stick, clove, cardamom.
notes: page 11; a faint word "fried" appears before "Cook on low for 12-15 mins" (looks like bleed-through, ignored); bay leaves, mint and raisins are listed from the method, no amounts

title: Shepherd's Pie
steps: Layer a dish with boiled potatoes, minced meat, noodles, ketchup.
Cook in oven for 1 hour at 180 C.
notes: page 12; ketchup is listed from the method; minced meat refers to the Samosa Keema recipe (page 7)

title: Tuna Kabab
steps: Mix all the ingredients, make patties, shallow fry.
notes: page 12

title: Mahshi

ingredients.name: mince cooked in ghee with black pepper, salt, maggi cube

steps: Cook meat, rice (sauteed in ghee only, not completely cooked, salt, maggie cube).
Cook tomato puree, maggie cube, salt, pepper.
Layer the stuffed capsicums on top of the tomato mixture.
Cook for about 5 minutes.
notes: page 13; page title is "Mahshi (Stuffed Capsicum / Kusa)"; the capsicum/kusa is not in the ingredient list, added from the title

title: Falafel
steps: Soak the beans overnight and grind everything together.
Add 1 tsp baking soda before frying.
notes: page 13; the Arabic word after "1 bunch" is read as dill (شبت) but I am not fully sure; baking soda is listed from the method

title: Spinach Fatayer
steps: Fry onion till dry add olive oil, salt, pepper, summac, lemon juice and spinach, mix well.
Make yeast mixture add flour and water, knead till soft.
Let rise for 2 hours.
Roll and fill with mixture.
Bake till golden and brush with olive oil.
notes: page 14; flour is listed twice in the book (3 cups and 1 cup), unclear why; no baking temperature or time written

title: Drumstick (Phally)

ingredients.name: coconut milk - dissolved in 1/2 cup water

steps: Fry onion in oil, add drumstick, tomato puree, spices, garlic.
Cook for about 20 mins, add shrimps and cook for 7-8 mins.
Add coconut milk till it boils.
Turn off the heat and fresh corriander.
notes: page 15; the page number is partly cut off at the photo edge

title: Shrimp and Sweet Potato (Jhingi Rataloo)
steps: Cook everything till almost done.
Add shrimps and cook for 8 mins.
Turn off heat and add fresh corriander.
notes: page 16; page title is "Shrimp and Sweet Potato (Jhingi Rataloo)"

title: Achar Masala (Kairy)

ingredients.name: mustard oil, heated then cooled to room temp

steps: For 1 Kg kairy use 3 Tbsp masala.
Masala: Roast till fragrant, cool, grind and store in clean jar.
Cut kairy to small pieces, let it dry.
Add masala and dry for 2 days keep mixing don't let it go bad.
Put in jar and add black seeds, 1 tsp haldi (turmeric), 3 tsp red chilli powder, 1 tsp salt top with mustard oil thats heated then cooled to room temp.
notes: page 17; the Arabic word for black seeds in brackets is hard to read, the "black seeds" reading is from the English; page title is "Achar Masala (Kairy)"

title: Bedekar Masala (Lemon Achar)
steps: Heat oil and roast everything, cool and grind.
Add red chilli powder.
notes: page 17; "asafateda" is the book's spelling (asafoetida, hing); no amounts for asafoetida, oil or chilli powder; the right edge of the page is partly cut off but the recipe looks complete

title: Chicken Ginglic
steps: Combine chicken with egg, soy sauce and cornflour, deep fry till it changes color but not cooked through.
In the same oil add ginger, garlic heat for a minute then add all ingredients except ketchup.
When chicken is cooked add the ketchup.
notes: page 18; title is spelled "Ginglic" in the book

title: Butter Chicken
steps: Coat chicken in ginger, garlic and spices.
Fry in little oil, not fully cooked.
In the same oil add cumin seeds, onion, ginger, garlic cook till soft.
Add spices, kasuri methi, chillies and tomato.
Cook on low heat till well done.
Cool down to room temp, make a fine paste in blender.
Add butter to a pan, chicken and tomato mixture.
Make it thinner with milk/water.
Add kasuri methi, ketchup and cream.
notes: page 19; butter, milk/water, ketchup and cream are listed from the method, no amounts

title: Ras Al-Usfoor
steps: Heat olive oil saute onions till soft.
Add the meat and spices.
When the water dries turn off and add summac, pomegranate molasses and lemon juice.
Serve in sandwiches with potato chips.
notes: page 20; page title is "Ra's Al-Usfoor"

title: Lebanese Sambousa
steps: Knead till hard, rest for half an hour.
Roll and fill with the Ras Al-Usfoor filling, fry.
notes: page 20; the book's title is "Lebanese Sambousa" with Arabic after it (سمبوسك لحم, meat sambousa); the Arabic word after "fill with" is hard to read and I could not read it with confidence, it may refer to the Ras Al-Usfoor filling on the same page; the dough ingredient list stops at the page bottom edge, possibly more below (the page appears to end there)

title: Meat/Chicken Majboos / Mandi
steps: Marinate chicken / meat in spices overnight.
Heat oil cook chicken in a pot (written in Arabic) till red not cooked through.
Add maggie cube and water to the pot and cook.
For meat cook in instant pot.
Place rack and 1/2 cup water at the bottom, put meat pieces and cook for 50 mins.
Take meat out, add maggie cube, meat juices, water, onion, rice (soaked and lumi), cook for 15 mins.
Add meat back in and cook for 5 mins.
Add cardamom powder, can add onion / garlic powder.
Give coal smoke to the rice and meat.
notes: page 21; the Arabic word after "cook chicken in" is unclear (maybe a word for ghee, not sure); the inserted line "cardamom powder, can add onion / garlic powder" is written above the line with a caret and I placed it after the cooking steps; no amounts for chicken/meat, rice, water; title on page is "Majboos / Mandi Chicken / Meat" with Arabic

title: Daqqus
steps: Saute garlic in olive oil, add the rest of the ingredients till potatoes are soft.
notes: page 21; page spelling is "Daqqus" with Arabic script after it

title: Spicy Squash Sabzi
steps: Mix ginger, fennel, coriander, red chilli powder, turmeric powder, paprika, add some water and make a paste.
Heat oil, add cumin seeds, hing, methi seeds, whole red chillies and fry for few seconds.
Add spice paste and cook for few mins till oil seperates.
Add squash and salt and some water.
Cover and cook on low/med till done.
Add mango powder, lemon juice and fresh corriander leaves.
notes: page 22

title: Tomato Chutney (with Dosa)
steps: Heat oil, add cumin seeds, mustard seeds, whole red chilli, then onion, hing, salt, red chilli powder.
Saute then add garlic.
Saute and add tomatoes.
Reduce heat and cook till oil seperates from mixture.
notes: page 23

title: Chicken Handi (with Methi)
steps: Heat oil and fry onion till golden brown (birista), add ginger, garlic, spices and tomatoes.
Cook till soft then add chicken, methi and yogurt till done.
Add cream at the end.
notes: page 24

title: Schezwan Sauce (Kabita's Kitchen)
notes: page 24; no method written in the book; the list runs to the bottom edge of the page so more lines may have been cut off by the photo

title: Beef and Broccoli
steps: Marinate the beef overnight, fry in wok over high heat.
Stir fry: Heat oil in a wok, add ginger, garlic, broccoli, cook till tender, add soy sauce and fried beef, add cornflour slurry to thicken.
notes: page 25; the page heading shows both "Beef and Broccoli" and "Chicken Schezwan" above the first recipe, the second looks like a heading that was not used there; the cornflour slurry line is on the right side of the garlic line

title: Chicken Schezwan

ingredients.name: chicken (marinated in cornflour, oil, soy sauce, pepper)

steps: Marinate chicken in cornflour, oil, soy sauce, pepper.
Fry and remove.
notes: page 25; the method stops at the bottom edge of the page and appears to be incomplete or cut off in the photo; chicken amount not written; use the Schezwan Sauce recipe (page 24)

title: Okra and Meat Gravy
steps: Cook meat with spices (approx 45 mins).
Saute onion till slightly soft.
Add the marinated meat with some water, okra.
Pressure cook everything for 5-10 mins.
notes: page 26; page title is "Okra Meat Gravy" with Arabic after it; the "approx 45 mins" is written above the line with an arrow to the meat-cooking step, so it is not necessarily the total time; the type of meat is not written ("meat"), search term is a guess

title: Chicken Do Pyaza
steps: Heat oil, add cumin seeds, red chilli (whole), onion, and cook till golden, add salt.
Add ginger, garlic and fry for 1 min.
Add spices and tomatoes, cook till softened.
Add chicken, fry, add yogurt and some water.
Cook till half done, add methi leaves, cook till chicken is done.
Add cut onion and cook for few mins.
Turn off heat and add corriander leaves (fresh).
notes: page 27; oil has no amount written

title: Chilli Potatoes

ingredients.name: Large potatoes, cut into sticks and boiled for 5 mins

steps: Batter: Dip the potato sticks in the batter and deep fry till golden.
Heat oil in a wok, fry ginger, garlic, chillies. Add capsicum and spring onions.
Add the rest of the ingredients and some water.
Add the potatoes, toss well till completely coated in the sauce.
Add slurry before the potatoes.
notes: page 28; the last line "Add slurry before the potatoes" is as written in the book (order of slurry/potatoes looks odd). Oil for frying is not in the ingredient list.

title: Swedish Meatballs
steps: Melt butter and cook onion till translucent.
Transfer onion to large bowl.
Add milk, egg, bread crumbs, spices, mince meat.
Mix everything and make balls, refrigerate for one hour.
Melt butter and fry meatballs in batches.
Sauce: Melt butter and add garlic and flour.
Slowly add the stock and the rest of the ingredients.
Add meat balls and cook on low heat for 10 mins.
notes: page 29; "mince" is written small above the line before "meat" in the method

title: Garlic Bread (By Ninik Becker)
steps: Mix all ingredients for dough and make a soft dough.
Rest for 1 hour.
Roll and place in baking tray, top with garlic butter mixture and cheese.
Bake at 190C for 15 mins.
notes: page 30; the dough ingredients have no heading in the book (first list); oven temperature is 190C (owner confirmed Celsius)

title: Gosht Salan (Light)
steps: Boil meat.
Make a masala by frying the onion till golden brown (birista).
Add garlic and spices.
Cook for 1-2 mins, add the cooked meat with its water.
Cook till it boils then add a Tbsp of tomato paste.
Serve with lemon and fresh coriander leaves.
notes: page 31; a bracket "Grind together coarsely" sits next to sauf and cumin seeds (covers sauf and cumin seeds only, owner confirmed); lemon and fresh coriander are in the method only

title: Chicken Salan
steps: Fry onions (birista) in oil till golden.
Add all the rest of the ingredients.
Cook for 10 mins in instant pot.
notes: page 32; page title is "Chicken Salan (Gravy)", index says Chicken Salan, used index title; the cinnamon amount is 1/4 stick (owner confirmed); "long" is written for cloves; "(birista)" is written small above the line

title: Zeera Matar Rice
steps: Heat ghee, saute zeera 30 secs, add soaked rice and wate[?]
[cut off at gutter] cook for 2 mins [?]. Cook on [cut off]
and salt. Cook 7+ mins, uncover and cook for 2 mins.
Cook on dum for 5 mins.
notes: page 32; the right edge of the method lines is cut off by the page gutter (words after "rice and wate" and after "Cook on" are missing, so the middle of the method is incomplete); no matar (peas) amount is in the ingredient list even though the title says matar; "7+" is written as "7 with a plus-minus sign" (about 7 mins)

title: Bolognese
steps: [Sa]ute onion in olive oil, add garlic.
Add rest of the [ingred]ients in instant pot and cook for 20 mins.
notes: page 33; the start of the method lines is cut off at the gutter ("ute onion", "...ients"), reconstructed words shown in brackets; olive oil is in the method only; "5,6" tomatoes written with a comma

title: Bechamel Sauce
steps: Heat butter, toast flour then add maggie, cook for 2-3 mins.
Add milk and cook till thickened, add pepper.
Turn off heat and add cheeses.
notes: page 33; the first words of the method lines touch the gutter and are slightly cut off but readable

title: Beans Salan
steps: Add all ingredients to instant pot cook for 30-40 mins.
Open lid, mix and add ghee.
Mash if you want.
Add fresh coriander leaves.
Serve with rice and tuna.
notes: page 34; the book says "bean" without saying which kind; the 1 Tbsp ghee appears in the list and again in the method

title: Muhammarah

ingredients.name: Pepper paste (written in Arabic as well)

steps: Fry onions till slightly soft.
Add pepper paste, then the rest of the ingredients except black seed and pomegranate molasses.
Turn off the heat, add black seed, pomegranate molasses and top with olive oil.
Dough: Knead and set aside for 10 mins.
Dough: Knead and make a very soft dough. Rest.
notes: page 35; the page title is Arabic only (looks like muhammara in Arabic), used index title Muhammarah; in the ingredients and method the book writes pepper paste, black seed and pomegranate molasses in Arabic script, I replaced them with the English meaning (pepper paste and pomegranate molasses are given in English next to the Arabic; black seed confirmed by owner); olive oil is in the method only; the dough is in two stages, first mix then a second mix of oil/salt/flour/butter (the book does not say how much of which goes where)

title: Soy Sauce Chicken
steps: Marinade the chicken in soy sauce.
Heat lots of oil in a wok.
Add garlic and fry for a minute then add the chicken.
Fry for 8 mins, then add onions and capsicum with black pepper.
Cook till chicken is done then add the sugar, stir and turn off the flame.
notes: page 36; oyster sauce is not mentioned in the method

title: Chicken Shawarma

ingredients.name: Chicken drumstick and thigh skin on

steps: Boil the chicken for 20 mins and shred when cooled.
To the chicken fat add all the ingredients and cook till the water evaporates.
Add the shredded chicken back and sliced onions and fry.
Turn off the heat and add lemon juice.
notes: page 37; no chicken quantity written; sliced onions and lemon juice are in the method only

title: Malai Tandoori Chicken (Naush Chicken)
steps: Marinate the chicken overnight, then fry in a little oil till half cooked and take out of pan.
For the Gravy: Melt butter, add 1/2 tsp ginger, 1/2 tsp garlic paste and saute.
Add 4 pureed tomatoes, salt.
Cook the gravy for few mins till tomatoes are soft.
Add the chicken and cook completely.
Turn off heat and add cream on top.
Give coal smoke.
notes: page 38; no chicken quantity written; the Gravy section has no ingredient list, its ingredient lines were taken from the method text (butter, salt and cream have no amount)

title: Dal Makhani

ingredients.name: Black dal, soaked and pressure cooked for 25 mins
Kidney beans, soaked and pressure cooked for 25 mins

steps: Heat oil add cumin seeds, chopped onions and saute.
Add ginger, garlic, saute.
Add spices and saute for 1 min.
Add tomato puree and cook on low heat for 10 mins.
Add cooked dal and cook for 10 mins.
Add 2 Tbsp of butter, kasuri methi.
Turn off heat and add 1/4 cup cream.
Give coal smoke.
notes: page 39; page title is "Dal Makhani (vah chef)"; oil, ginger and garlic are in the method only (no amounts); the "1 green chilli" is part of the tomato line

title: Chicken Nachos / Tacos (Rockin Robin)

ingredients.name: Roasted capsicum (broiled then skinned when cooled)

steps: Marinade the chicken in the spices overnight, minus the tomato paste.
Cook chicken for 20 mins with little water.
After it is done, shred it.
Saute onions in the same pan till softened then add tomato paste and shredded chicken and chipotle sauce.
notes: page 40; "Chicken" is written as a sub-heading above the list (no amount), I made it an ingredient line; the right edge of the method is slightly cut off at "softened" and "chipotle" but readable; the cornflour and paprika are in a second column to the right of the list

title: Beef Nachos (Laura in the kitchen)
steps: Saute beef then add onions till soft.
Add rest of the ingredients.
Add chipotle sauce at the end.
notes: page 40; no amounts written in the book (ingredients are a comma list); chipotle sauce is in the method only; "olive oil" is written "dive oil" (olive oil)

title: Sheesh Tawooq (Chef Ahmad All cooking)
steps: Marinade the chicken overnight with all the spices.
Barbeque till done.
notes: page 41; the page title is Arabic only (shish tawook), the English attribution is as written; the lemon line reads "1/2 lemon juice"

title: Achari Gosht

ingredients.name: Fennel seeds, saunf (make a coarse powder)

steps: Heat oil and fry onions till lightly golden.
Add tomato puree cook for 5 mins.
Add the marinated beef/meat and roast for 5 mins.
Add water and pressure cook for 20-30 mins.
notes: page 42; the book does not say the marinade steps (the yogurt, turmeric and chili are presumably the marinade); the bracket "Make a coarse powder" covers fennel, cumin, methi and coriander seeds (black seeds are not included, owner confirmed); the black seeds line also has an Arabic word written after it

title: Mutton Karahi
steps: Pressure cook the mutton with onion, salt, tomato, ginger and garlic till 90% done.
Dry the water a little in the karahi on high flame.
Add oil and cook for 5 mins.
Add red chili powder and cook till oil seperates.
Add yogurt and cook then add cumin powder, coriander powder, black pepper, cook till dry.
Top with fresh coriander, ginger juliennes and lemon juice.
notes: page 43; salt, fresh coriander, ginger juliennes and lemon juice are in the method only (no amounts); the word "seperates" is as written

title: Arayes
steps: Blend all ingredients.
Spread on khubz and cook on med-high for 5-7 mins with olive oil.
notes: page 44; the page title also has the Arabic word for arayes; parsley and pomegranate molasses are written in Arabic script next to the line, I used the English meaning; khubz and olive oil are in the method only

title: Sliced Aloo Onion
steps: Put all ingredients in pan and cook on med-low till golden brown and caramelised.
notes: page 44

title: Moong Dal Samosa

ingredients.name: Moong dal soaked and boiled (20 min+) not pressure cooked

steps: Saute the onions, add spices except amchur and corriander leaves after turning off the flame.
notes: page 45; this is the filling only (no samosa pastry or oil listed); "(20 min+)" is written as 20 min with a plus-minus sign; "dices" is as written

title: Garam Masala Powder
steps: Grind all the ingredients together.
notes: page 45; the page title is spelled "Garam Mesala Powder" in the book

title: Patora
steps: Balance the sweet, sour, saltyness of the mixture.
It must be of henna consistency.
Keep the ribbed part of leaves up towards you.
Tie with a cloth and steam for 25-30 mins on a rack in a deep pan with little water (at the bottom).
Cool overnight, slice, fry and eat.
notes: page 46; "imly" (imli) is tamarind

title: Khichrda

ingredients.name: Mixed daals, soaked (dals, rice, barley, beans, oats)

steps: Cook seperately the dals and the wheat.
After the wheat is cooked blend it into a paste (smooth).
Add vegetables like pumpkin and kusa with the dals.
Fry onions, when slightly golden add green chillies, ginger, garlic and fry.
Add meat and cook 5-10 mins.
Add spices and tomatoes.
Pressure cook 25 mins.
Mix the dals, coconut, wheat and meat in a large pot cook on dum for 1/2 hour.
Sprinkle fresh coriander, mint and cook for a minute.
Serve with lemon, coriander, mint and ginger juliennes.
notes: page 47; "lumi powder" is lumi (Arabic), dried lemon (owner confirmed); vegetables, fresh coriander, mint, lemon and ginger juliennes are in the method only (no amounts); "kusa" is probably zucchini/squash

title: Sheet Pan Kabab

ingredients.name: Onion + 1 red capsicum blend, squeeze out water and add to the mixture

steps: Mix all the ingredients, place in sheet pan, make lines to form kababs.
Keep in fridge 4 hrs or overnight.
Bake for 30 mins at full heat on bottom shelf covered along with cooked tomatoes, sliced onions.
Uncover and broil for 10 mins.
Give coal smoke and saffron water.
notes: page 48; the onion and red capsicum are written on one line ("1 onion + 1 red capsicum blend..."), so there is a duplicate line for the capsicum; tomatoes, sliced onions and saffron water are in the method only

title: Hashw for Mandi/Majboos
steps: Pressure cook chana dal till 90% done.
Sute onions in pan without oil, keep adding few drops of water to avoid sticking.
Fry till slightly golden add little oil, raisins, cooked chana dal and cook for few mins.
Serve with Mandi / Majboos.
notes: page 49; the page title has an Arabic word (hashw) between "Hashw" and "for"; "Sute" is as written (saute); oil is in the method only

title: Instant Marag for Kabab (Turkish)
steps: Saute garlic in little oil, add maggie cube then tomato paste.
Saute for 1-2 mins then add water and cook on low for 5-7 mins.
notes: page 49; the page title has an Arabic word (marag) in place of "Marag" in the middle; oil is in the method only

title: Berry Rice

ingredients.name: Zereshk (barberries; written in Arabic in the book)

steps: Boil water then add salt, soaked rice and cook 7 mins, put dum 5 mins.
While rice is cooking in a small pan melt butter, add zereshk (written in Arabic) and cook for 1-1.5 mins.
Add saffron water, turn off heat.
When rice is done pour this mixture on the rice along with extra butter and let melt.
Open lid after 5 mins and fluff rice, serve with Turkish Kabab.
notes: page 50; the book's title is "Berry Rice" with an Arabic word (zereshk = barberries) beside it; the barberries are written in Arabic in the ingredient list and method, zereshk (owner confirmed); saffron water is used in the method but saffron is not in the ingredient list

title: Lahm Bi Ajeen (Chef Haider Deek)

ingredients.name: Pomegranate molasses (written in Arabic, dibs rumman)

steps: Add everything to a chopper and place on khubz (bread) / Fatayer dough.
See muhammara dough recipe.
notes: page 51; the book's title is in Arabic (Lahm Bi Ajeen, meat on dough) followed by (Chef Haider Deek); an Arabic word after "parsley" (a gloss, read as the Arabic for parsley) was omitted; "2 Tbsp" ingredient is in Arabic, pomegranate molasses (owner confirmed); the Arabic word before "dough recipe" at the end is muhammara (see the Muhammarah dough, page 35)

title: Burger
steps: Mix all the ingredients and shape burger patties.
Keep in fridge.
notes: page 52

title: Pizza Sauce
steps: Saute onions in large pot without oil, when dried add little oil and add pureed tomato mixture, add spices and cook down.
Add garlic and tomato paste, cook for 2-3 mins.
Turn off heat and add honey.

title: Chocolate and Peanut Butter Cereal

ingredients.name: Peanut butter (melt in bowl and pour over oats)
Honey / maple syrup (melt in bowl and pour over oats)
Butter (melt in bowl and pour over oats)
Cinnamon powder (melt in bowl and pour over oats)
Salt (melt in bowl and pour over oats)

steps: Melt the peanut butter, honey / maple syrup, butter, cinnamon and salt in a bowl and pour over oats.
Press onto 2 baking sheets in a thin layer at 165C / 325F for 20-25 mins, flip and cook for 10-15 mins until golden.
Let cool completely then break into clusters and add chocolate chips.
notes: page 49; the bracket 'Melt in bowl and pour over oats' appears to cover peanut butter through salt (salt is included, owner confirmed)

title: Orange Chocolate Cereal
steps: Bake at 165C / 325F for 20 mins then broil for 3 mins on low.
Let it cool completely then break into clusters and add chocolate chips.
notes: page 50; the title is written 'Orange Chololate Cereal' in the book (typo); no mixing instructions
